node.statement: In the ambient configuration quantified in node 1, lem-routef-raw-factor-setting-formation supplies the single global W_RF and the datum S, while lem-routef-delta-prime-closeness, lem-routef-delta-normalization-closeness, lem-routef-upsilon-prime-closeness, and lem-routef-upsilon-normalization-closeness supply the stipulated Delta', Delta, Upsilon', and Upsilon in that order. Applying lem-routef-k-finiteness to exactly this chain gives that K is a finite universal real scalar and rho_fac>0. Moreover, equation (1.6) of def-routef-raw-factor-setting defines K as a maximum whose entries include 1, so K>=1>0.
